[EN] I saw Seren once. Her beauty, her grace were haunting. She seemed to float, not walk and as she moved I got the distinct sense that she had no clue I was there.
[ES] Vi a Seren una vez. Su belleza, su gracia eran cautivadoras. Parecía flotar, no caminar, y mientras se movía tuve la clara sensación de que no tenía idea de que yo estaba allí.
